sourceCorrections: Push Press source record has empty instructions; exact Catalyst push-press page supplies method.
Hang Clean source omits the catch; elbow turnover and front-rack receive restored.
Incline Push-Up Depth Jump source setup is feet elevated, and guide states this.
Bench Jump goes OVER bench; Front Box Jump goes ONTO box; both preserved.
Band Good Morning records put band at neck; editorial guide moves pressure onto upper-back muscles.
Deadlift records prescribe back arch and leaning back; guide uses firm trunk and upright finish.
Original maximum-effort, failure-time, fixed calorie and bodyweight prescriptions removed.
Loaded jumps and drop/rebound variations retained with specific landing setup and easier drills.
loggingNotes: 22 timed drills use seconds; 13 cardio exercises use minutes. Distance field in meters referenced for traveling drills per root implementation plan.

Bar/axle/frame/log/yoke loads use total implement plus plates. Farmer carry and dumbbell crucifix are per-hand equal pairs, multiplier 2. Circus bell uses per-arm reps completed on both sides, multiplier 2. Two-hand one-dumbbell jumps and swings use multiplier 1.
Car-deadlift and Conan wheel lever loads are note-only; vehicle or plate mass is not falsely treated as handle force.
Band force and changing chain contribution kept separate from total bar-and-plate entry; progression off.
No automatic ordinary load progression for plyometric, strongman, Olympic or cardio records.
reviewScope: Editorial source-based exercise guides. Exact imported original cues matched the local verified upstream dataset for every assigned ID; no independent expert certification or technique assessment is claimed.
